def f(n):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cs=comps_of(inp); tpl=max(cs,key=len)
    my=min(y for y,_ in tpl); mx=min(x for _,x in tpl)
    hh=max(y for y,_ in tpl)-my+1; ww=max(x for _,x in tpl)-mx+1
    T=[[inp[y][x] for x in range(mx,mx+ww)] for y in range(my,my+hh)]
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    mk=[sorted(min(c)) for c in cs if len(c)<len(tpl)]
    for iy,ix in mk:
        dy = -(my - iy)   # top row of stamp at marker row
        dx = -(mx + (ww-1)//2 - ix)  # center col of stamp at marker col
        for r in range(hh):
            for c in range(ww):
                yy_=iy+dy+r; xx_=ix+dx+c
                if 0<=yy_<H and 0<=xx_<W: out[yy_][xx_]=T[r][c]
    return out
for n in [5,6,7,8]:
    o=f(n); e=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    diff=[(y,x,o[y][x],e[y][x]) for y in range(len(e)) for x in range(len(e[0])) if o[y][x]!=e[y][x]]
    print('demo',n,'ndiff:',len(diff),'first:',diff[:4])

def comps_of(inp,H,W):
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in inp for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
